title: Urban Wonders of Tokyo and Osaka
alt: Crowds crossing Shibuya at night, Tokyo
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Disneyland
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Mount Fuji and Hakone, and a full day at Tokyo Disneyland.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Hiroshima, Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel one stop from Namba, in central Osaka

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima day trip
activities.match: Hiroshima and Miyajima Full Day Bus Tour
activities.description: A long day west to the Peace Memorial Park, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine.

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, with a buffet lunch and coach travel from Namba.

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Japan with tickets included, home to Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Five nights in one hotel with day trips to Hiroshima, Kyoto and Nara, a walking tour and a day at Universal Studios Japan.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway
Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening
4: Early breakfast, then across to Tokyo Disneyland
Admission tickets included for the full day
5: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Shinkansen bullet train south to Osaka
Check in at your hotel near Namba
Rest of the day free in the city
6: Early breakfast, then a full day bus tour west
The Peace Memorial Park and the A-Bomb Dome
The floating torii gate before the ride back
7: Breakfast, then a full day out to Kyoto and Nara
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
8: Breakfast, then a half day walking tour of Osaka
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
The lanes around Shinsekai with your guide
9: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
10: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Five nights in one Osaka hotel and every big day out reachable from it. You see more and unpack once.
expert.tip: The Hiroshima day is long. Sleep on the bus both ways and keep the Osaka walking tour for the day after, as we have.

summary: Ten days with four nights in Shinjuku for a city tour, Mount Fuji and Tokyo Disneyland, then five nights in one Osaka hotel with day trips to Hiroshima and Miyajima, Kyoto and Nara, a walking tour and Universal Studios Japan.
included: Included: 9 nights with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train from Tokyo down to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; admission to Tokyo Disneyland; a guided day to Hiroshima with Miyajima island; Kyoto and Nara day trip with buffet lunch; a half day on foot through Osaka; entry to Universal Studios Japan.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
